Brencis.statement: He was in the past. Not under Brencis – if that's what you mean.

Brencis.speaker: Coen
Brencis.statement: Mert sent me. He was captured by Brencis's men.

Brencis.speaker: Coen
Brencis.statement: I've been disrupting Brencis's rule for some time now.

Brencis.speaker: B42D500B4AD603DA55FB488E66A2FBC5
Brencis.statement: I've been disrupting Brencis's rule for some time now.

Brencis.speaker: Marat
Brencis.statement: Kill some soldiers, destroy blood transports, build a reputation for yourself... The moment I see Brencis coming after you, I’ll know I can trust you.

Brencis.speaker: Q106_Rebel_HQ_Guard
Brencis.statement: I say, you must’ve really pissed Brencis off. Every damned guard in the city’s out hunting for you.

Brencis.speaker: Q106_Random_Rebel3
Brencis.statement: Aye. But once Brencis is gone, we’ll finally have peace.

Brencis.speaker: Q106_Random_Rebel5
Brencis.statement: With Brencis breathing down our necks, it's harder to get... anything.

Brencis.speaker: Drogos
Brencis.statement: Deciphering messages from our stashes... Good thing Brencis’ men don’t have it anymore. But you – you should learn to read our code.

Brencis.speaker: Coen
Brencis.statement: I broke into one of Brencis's warehouses. This was among the items seized by the soldiers.

Brencis.speaker: Coen
Brencis.statement: Might dissuade others from joining Brencis's ranks. She did well.

Brencis.speaker: Coen
Brencis.statement: There was a boy she knew... on his way to join Brencis's army.

Brencis.speaker: F26750E14C8BE1F0B7F3EBBEED0B0B7A
Brencis.statement: It just struck me – maybe Brencis chose Vale Sangora for this very reason.

Brencis.speaker: E9C189F742BB23F465A9829E588D8339
Brencis.statement: I don’t take unnecessary risks. If we chased every tall tale, it'd be Judgement Day before we defeated Brencis.

Brencis.speaker: 911D40AF4BE76C9179AF429DDC39E61D
Brencis.statement: Brencis's soldiers... they’ve been acting quite suspicious lately.

Brencis.speaker: 5FBB97F94A13974E66C544B913B18DBD
Brencis.statement: But first prove to me that you're better man than Brencis.

Brencis.speaker: 71189E4D48FCA60BFCF5F9ACACFA5E7A
Brencis.statement: Brencis... building an army... Those things! Monsters! Must be killed...

Brencis.speaker: Vladimir
Brencis.statement: For now, yeah. But doing what we do... Each day, you feel Brencis breathing down your neck.

Brencis.speaker: Ambrus
Brencis.statement: Brencis will be pleased when I hand him your head.

Brencis.speaker: Coen
Brencis.statement: I can't believe Brencis will be no more.

Brencis.speaker: Lacra
Brencis.statement: Eh... It's my redemption, too. I'm here to undo my mistakes. I fell for Brencis's tricks.

Brencis.speaker: Lacra
Brencis.statement: Brencis must've procured it somewhere, set it to guard this place. I hope he had just the one.

Brencis.speaker: Lacra
Brencis.statement: I did. Keep your eyes peeled, Coen. Those weren't Brencis's men.

Brencis.speaker: Coen
Brencis.statement: There was this man working for Brencis. Creating these atrocities.

Brencis.speaker: Ambrus
Brencis.statement: Brencis blessed me, and I have every intention of paying him back for this gift.

Brencis.speaker: 93EC025640BFE39A49B85298859989C6
Brencis.statement: Brencis's rule won't last forever.

Brencis.speaker: Coen
Brencis.statement: Brencis's rule won't last forever. Better jump ship before it sinks.

Brencis.speaker: Lacra
Brencis.statement: Brencis is planning something. We shouldn't waste time.

Brencis.speaker: Coen
Brencis.statement: Must be how Brencis's men move around here.

Brencis.speaker: Lacra
Brencis.statement: Brencis's ritual damaged it, and here we are.

Brencis.speaker: Lacra
Brencis.statement: For all his hubris, Brencis is smart and doesn't take safety for granted.

Brencis.speaker: Lacra
Brencis.statement: She was older than Brencis. Her mind was going, she wasn't at her full strength. I think that's what saved us.

Brencis.speaker: Lacra
Brencis.statement: We don't have to fight, Xanthe. You're not loyal to Brencis.

Brencis.speaker: Coen
Brencis.statement: Draw your blade and fight, Brencis. Or I'll cut you down as you stand.

Brencis.speaker: Coen
Brencis.statement: No, Brencis. You'll have to deal with both of us.

Brencis.speaker: BECCD88A4B0807C43BB1989FFF8BA28A
Brencis.statement: No. We fight Brencis together.

Brencis.speaker: Lacra
Brencis.statement: I've been looking forward to this, Brencis. I've wanted to see you squirm for so long.

Brencis.speaker: C48E16D24D386C14BDB76FB9D69894F5
Brencis.statement: We just want to kill Brencis. Plain and simple.

Brencis.speaker: F8B5263247396D3738D94BA45C9857E3
Brencis.statement: We only seek to kill Brencis – avenge those he’s taken from us. And make better lives for ourselves.

Brencis.speaker: 99F398864E12C78675A94E8AD606C7F4
Brencis.statement: You see, Brencis claims to be both life and death, and everything in between. It’s just a lie he tells both himself and everybody else to delay the inevitable.

Brencis.speaker: B13F8D9F4157AE56A3F628AC356DAD7A
Brencis.statement: They had no choice but to fight for Brencis. But they’re still Sangorans. Show them mercy and they’ll be forever grateful to you.

Brencis.speaker: 65A9CDD74E61D1F6658D57BFA3D65F03
Brencis.statement: Oh, I’d bet on Brencis to slaughter them. He’s far better equipped.

Brencis.speaker: 0EC5F2AB4E4701D68C67089094CF98A4
Brencis.statement: Aye. But word of our assault will reach Brencis soon. He'll be furious, send most of his men to retake this post. That's our cue.

Brencis.speaker: E8E9762846C300DC492375A1E2CC84C3
Brencis.statement: Besides, word of our assault will reach Brencis soon. He'll be furious, send most of his men to retake this post. That's our cue.

Brencis.speaker: AEEE49C84DAB7D48510228BBF2B729AC
Brencis.statement: Not exactly. My friend suspected Brencis is preparing something terrible. But I have no idea what, really.

Brencis.speaker: 2637677E448329AC1F8AE48EC8C3FF15
Brencis.statement: Seems like Brencis is preparing a ritual of sorts... using the prisoners.

Brencis.speaker: 7038C3AC49945C38C5B69996AB1F463E
Brencis.statement: Out of the way! It's Brencis I want, not you!

Brencis.speaker: 3A16A99E4553542D0C2F6FACF91DBD1C
Brencis.statement: Brencis's rule won't last forever.

Brencis.speaker: 0F8B086847D3F600676A59B65069C9D0
Brencis.statement: Brencis's rule won't last forever. Better to jump ship, before it sinks.

Brencis.speaker: ED6FA7DD4989E4CD99F32FA9CB238B5A
Brencis.statement: Knyaz Brencis blessed me, and I have every intention of paying him back for this gift.

Brencis.speaker: 70B046E94D4E841A1E27868694D1AE5A
Brencis.statement: Knyaz Brencis is busy with matters far more important than this little intrusion.

Brencis.speaker: 93E980FC4B6A952A398E1AB2020C136B
Brencis.statement: Brencis... He won’t stop… unless you stop him.

Brencis.speaker: 90D782E948DA9405404634AC27A63DEC
Brencis.statement: Coen, stop stalling. Brencis is still out there, slaughtering my men!

Brencis.speaker: 25B2CE364E278BAFFCDD1CBC079878BA
Brencis.statement: Don’t forget about Xanthe. She might be nearby, or by Brencis’s side.

Brencis.speaker: 6BBA1C244EA6B1425C7A33821B582875
Brencis.statement: Enough! Brencis is still out there, slaughtering my men!

Brencis.speaker: F331E3074B4873A677C02EBA2143A639
Brencis.statement: Old crone's done for... Now it’s Brencis’s turn.

Brencis.speaker: E48524014E9AEDCB4C920680843608A3
Brencis.statement: So much for the blood slaves... Now it’s Brencis’s turn.

Brencis.speaker: 7C36818F4FEC4043E9A3AABAF0B6D921
Brencis.statement: Guh.. Finish him off... Kill Brencis for me!

Brencis.speaker: 7039093340F246BC658A84AB395205B3
Brencis.statement: I appreciate what you did… and you'll be rewarded… but it won’t matter if Brencis lives to see another day.

Brencis.speaker: BB25B29D4B6C7D50E82A048176CAA982
Brencis.statement: He rushed into combat, let Brencis's men surround us. It was carnage.

Brencis.speaker: B28A00534C3E21AC29CEAA93E66D1315
Brencis.statement: Not while Brencis is alive.

Brencis.speaker: C98E54D743865E7F03AE8A857386652C
Brencis.statement: We must kill Brencis. Whatever the cost.

Brencis.speaker: 88A22F354DCB9B2FE42455982EBD2093
Brencis.statement: Rush all you will, but the moment for you has passed. Brencis has already prepared his... surprise for you.

Brencis.speaker: F313E68D46D30C1FFBD8068D974C5BB8
Brencis.statement: Never understood why Brencis spared a pest like you. He's a bloody fool after all...

Brencis.speaker: CA20F6B3421EAF8C74B847BB35201F0E
Brencis.statement: Brencis blessed me, and I have every intention of paying him back for this gift.

Brencis.speaker: 52E97EA04B889347A81898BB153EA09B
Brencis.statement: Listen to me. We don't have to fight. And Brencis's rule won't last forever.

Brencis.speaker: A9987B394E51F015BB1F16B9F032D2B8
Brencis.statement: And then... there's Brencis. The devil himself.

Brencis.speaker: BB63E486496F6C372CDEA09379A42408
Brencis.statement: The worst. Brencis, he made these things... Winged, with scythes for arms...

Brencis.speaker: 9E0D6F2A4C1447813B5A9AA63A8ACB50
Brencis.statement: Brencis went to the dungeons.

Brencis.speaker: F98CB1244750759DD583748DAF4A1B74
Brencis.statement: Their blood may have been chosen. And if it was, they'll be meeting Brencis soon.

Brencis.speaker: 029B33D94288929322A2A29CB6F5E5E2
Brencis.statement: It's... a war room - where all of Brencis's schemes originate.

Brencis.speaker: BEB2B4AC4D8C0FDF6D520BA104A869ED
Brencis.statement: Do you know where Brencis is?

Brencis.speaker: E85DDAA34D9A0A0616FF76BE0C9F1FA5
Brencis.statement: Do you know where Brencis is?

Brencis.speaker: C93C3573416FC34FD9C940A95B051AF3
Brencis.statement: I can't. I have to get Brencis.

Brencis.speaker: 2DF1E0F94C039F44CEA12281930B1222
Brencis.statement: I need to kill Brencis. And you're free because of me. I'm the one that killed Bakir.

Brencis.speaker: FAA2A35D4D4504978742F290643F06BA
Brencis.statement: Brencis was here?

Brencis.speaker: FD60E62C4B26FE4FB7467FA6324A2D62
Brencis.statement: Brencis was here?

Brencis.speaker: 67F792504EA24972B12F498A73E99182
Brencis.statement: Th-they were here, yes! But Brencis took them. They're in the pit with him!

Brencis.speaker: 1A888A9C4CD83CEAD4EC88954303FFBF
Brencis.statement: You're Brencis's accomplice. You're just as responsible.

Brencis.speaker: D1BDFA8A4B3589E60EBF7C9F64570328
Brencis.statement: It's all my fault. If only I'd acted sooner, Brencis wouldn't –

Brencis.speaker: EA6AF2204BE9279413374F94EC466EEE
Brencis.statement: I'm regretting striking a deal with Brencis.

Brencis.speaker: 0C2C38124F1E3956BEF4AEB8A00FB372
Brencis.statement: Brencis... changed me forever. And even now... he still haunts me.

Brencis.speaker: 95E25AAE406CD43380C853A1230FFE7D
Brencis.statement: I killed Brencis. Vale Sangora is free again.

Brencis.speaker: 0696D63C49201389985F0FA9348AEDA8
Brencis.statement: Knyaz Brencis will leave us alone. I made sure of it.

Brencis.speaker: CC99EE4C457B8318C732D097574EF043
Brencis.statement: Gremla... Brencis will keep up his end of the bargain. I made sure of it.

Brencis.speaker: 2B83763D4A193ED15E6D5FA0C3652F3E
Brencis.statement: The soldiers stationed there... Dutiful men, very loyal to Knyaz Brencis.

Brencis.speaker: 50C8587942A8D53EC4A365867A5B1A79
Brencis.statement: Brencis might be burning in Hell right now, but there are other beasts haunting our valley.

Brencis.speaker: 9D6695934A11DBD90E863FBC0EB6877C
Brencis.statement: Brencis... he had my family and it was the only –

Brencis.speaker: CC851EDF4C4C6C9DCEDC028A264A02CE
Brencis.statement: Oh, the city is as busy as ever. With Brencis dead, things are finally changing. People have hope again!

Brencis.speaker: 5C0D8BE84B7905608C1126BADFDCF433
Brencis.statement: Vlad, I had no choice. Brencis was about to kill my family –

Brencis.speaker: 7A4E125B4FE726A1C94BCCB90E97405F
Brencis.statement: You sold us to Brencis. Crake and many good men and women died because of you.

Brencis.speaker: 07DACAA249D468B6147479BCCC264277
Brencis.statement: Knyaz Brencis forbade anyone from poking around in them, but now... I bet lots of folk will see the opportunity.

Brencis.speaker: 478E56EC4806B9572B07828683E0144A
Brencis.statement: Brencis is dead, Catalin is dead... Before long, people will start fighting over who'll be the next ruler.

Brencis.speaker: 907FCC2C4460A354DB2BD3AB2B5257F6
Brencis.statement: All uriash do. Vrakhiri dead, Brencis rule ended – we return mountains.

Brencis.speaker: 4CD0D56146B1FE8D6E400CB9BF533FBC
Brencis.statement: Now, Brencis dead. Vrakhiri no rule, so uriash return mountain. But I stay in city. Hide.

Brencis.speaker: 24130F554FA6A802F7649CB583AF4C87
Brencis.statement: The only thing I'm certain of is that I'll never be free, not really. Brencis made sure of that.

Brencis.speaker: 40886F98478A22B689EBCDBDE2B877F9
Brencis.statement: Brencis has broken every law there is. And so, he shall be punished.

Brencis.speaker: A030D78E42F497CAAADE649573009D87
Brencis.statement: No. I still have to clean up the mess made by Brencis and his lackeys.

Brencis.speaker: 78B76A2C4CCFE3158D31238A0F298E34
Brencis.statement: No. Someone still has to take care of Brencis.

Brencis.speaker: 61787A1E4A039C8FAEC9CE9FE5E38581
Brencis.statement: They are my... superiors. Suffice it to say, they do not appreciate Brencis's claim of power.

Brencis.speaker: 9F7BD24446B154EBB49781B192F793A3
Brencis.statement: Vicho, the Council of Augurs appreciates your decision to play no role in Brencis's madness.

Brencis.speaker: 2A155C47403F6828AAE82FBBD4F1DFC9
Brencis.statement: As soon as Brencis was dethroned, most of Father Florin's flock turned against him - and those still loyal to the priest couldn't protect him.

Brencis.speaker: D281804842F516A92EEEF5B4D66D7B31
Brencis.statement: Having learned of Florin's betrayal, Brencis showed little mercy. He was so offended he even refused to drink the fallen priest's blood.

Brencis.speaker: 434A55A24A148094BD38B3B44829B3EB
Brencis.statement: After I defeated Brencis – without her help, and so to her great annoyance – she swiftly moved on to other business, travelled to other lands.

Brencis.speaker: B4740DE4493D9441322379A30CC28A01
Brencis.statement: Lacra did not linger in Vale Sangora. Having defeated Brencis with my help, she swiftly moved on to other tasks, travelled to other places.

Brencis.speaker: A0ECE4F243D53BCC10EDEF8D4882CABE
Brencis.statement: Lacra was arrogant enough to think she could take Brencis and his clique on her own, without my help.

Brencis.speaker: B544EFEC4135EE63EAA1E38D600286F8
Brencis.statement: Any rebellion is dangerous... And a rebellion against the vrakhiri doubly so. Without my help, the manumits did not outlast Brencis.

Brencis.speaker: FD9875B841C639C937411894C68D1042
Brencis.statement: Marat was determined and ruthless. Unfortunately for him, so was Brencis.

Brencis.speaker: F37A054A47A6178748EE2C81EAFC4EB3
Brencis.statement: The manumits hoped that, with Brencis gone, they could go back to their old lives, hang up their weapons and leave them to gather dust.

Brencis.speaker: 3FCDCAB94623908530AD9BA3CBE7E777
Brencis.statement: The manumits were the last spark of opposition Brencis had to contend with... And with my help, he extinguished it once and for all.

Brencis.speaker: 148C549949AF949D5D0540B18C8D1D9B
Brencis.statement: Brencis was gone... But so was Catalin. With his death, Vale Sangora faced an uncertain future.

Brencis.speaker: F75A076E457A032CBE51429071CF094F
Brencis.statement: Brencis was gone... With no one to replace him. Vale Sangora faced an uncertain future.

Brencis.speaker: 8116342643411B45993E158A2B5FEA76
Brencis.statement: The city cathedral was remodelled in keeping with Brencis's wishes.

Brencis.speaker: D84BF1B949CD8A19823CCC80902D3A4B
Brencis.statement: I spared Xanthe and her daughter. I still wonder why. Was it only to gain an ally in my fight with Brencis...

Brencis.speaker: Coen
Brencis.statement: Brencis's men know something's afoot.

Brencis.speaker: Coen
Brencis.statement: Holy images... Hacked to pieces, as Brencis ordered.

Brencis.speaker: sq004.uriash
Brencis.statement: Brencis strong. Brencis order we kill. I do not want kill.

Brencis.speaker: sq004.uriash
Brencis.statement: People talk. Say Brencis bad. Say attack Brencis.

Brencis.speaker: Coen
Brencis.statement: Brencis needs us alive. Much like we need our cattle.

Brencis.speaker: Gremla
Brencis.statement: Oh, you don't know knyaz Brencis like I do.

Brencis.speaker: Gremla
Brencis.statement: Someone took the banner! The one Knyaz Brencis ordered for the church, to replace the old cross. And Mass is tonight!

Brencis.speaker: Gremla
Brencis.statement: When Knyaz Brencis demanded the village made a new banner for the church, no one was willing to!

Brencis.speaker: Coen
Brencis.statement: Angering Brencis will put my family at risk.

Brencis.speaker: Coen
Brencis.statement: Brencis won't let it slide. If the banner isn't there for Mass, he'll kill someone.

Brencis.speaker: Coen
Brencis.statement: I don't want Brencis angry and lashing out.

Brencis.speaker: Coen
Brencis.statement: Nobody sent me. Just trying to make sure we don't anger Brencis. Because if we do, there will be consequences.

Brencis.speaker: Premysl
Brencis.statement: This is what Brencis wants to hang over the altar, where the holy cross used to be.

Brencis.speaker: Coen
Brencis.statement: Even if you succeed, you'll still have Brencis to worry about.

Brencis.speaker: Coen
Brencis.statement: I thought Brencis forbade drinking from people.

Brencis.speaker: Iulian
Brencis.statement: See, Ambrus doesn't drink from Brencis's communal blood barrels.

Brencis.speaker: Ambrus
Brencis.statement: Oh, we did have the problem, but we certainly did not have a solution. Not before Brencis.

Brencis.speaker: Coen
Brencis.statement: You're a pawn in Brencis's hands, Ambrus, nothing more. You don't really rule anyone.

Brencis.speaker: Coen
Brencis.statement: I won't take insults from Brencis's lackeys.

Brencis.speaker: 709_Commander
Brencis.statement: Knyaz Brencis is a vrakhir, yes. But he is a just liege, better than Skender ever was.

Brencis.speaker: Xanthe
Brencis.statement: You stand in Brencis's way, not mine. His goals are not my own, he was merely a convenience.

Brencis.speaker: Coen
Brencis.statement: He was wearing Brencis's colours. This is one of Leonard's men sent to find the girls... Shit. So much for that.

Brencis.speaker: Coen
Brencis.statement: Only if I manage to save our family from Brencis.

Brencis.speaker: Coen
Brencis.statement: Only if I save our family from Brencis.

Brencis.speaker: Florin
Brencis.statement: At first, I believed in Brencis. I thought him an angel of the Lord, walking amongst us men.

Brencis.speaker: Coen
Brencis.statement: Brencis is our enemy. Together we might just stand a chance of taking him down.

Brencis.speaker: Florin
Brencis.statement: Brencis is the Adversary. Siding with that monster leads only to damnation.

Brencis.speaker: Florin
Brencis.statement: But now I see I was mistaken. Brencis is the Adversary, who is testing our faith and resolve.

Brencis.speaker: Coen
Brencis.statement: But you willingly participated in Brencis's madness. All of it. The killing, the torture... draining blood from the weak.

Brencis.speaker: Florin
Brencis.statement: Just remember: when Brencis is finally overthrown, when once again Vale Sangora returns to our Lord's embrace...

Brencis.speaker: Coen
Brencis.statement: Yet you did nothing to stop Brencis from draining her like everyone else.

Brencis.speaker: Coen
Brencis.statement: You're the head of Brencis's church! I saw you baptise a child with blood!

Brencis.speaker: Coen
Brencis.statement: Brencis's men... Better keep a low profile.

Brencis.speaker: SQ713_Village_woman
Brencis.statement: So Brencis's men don't steal it from me, like they have everything else! Now get out of my face!

Brencis.speaker: Marat
Brencis.statement: Hah. I have this recurring fantasy – we've slain Brencis. I'm celebrated as the valley's saviour. Me, a Tatar!

Brencis.speaker: Marat
Brencis.statement: No, you listen. If we attack alone, we die. If we wait much longer, Brencis will finally sniff us out and – you guessed it – we die.

Brencis.speaker: Marat
Brencis.statement: Oh, yeah. Brencis would tremble to know our ranks were bolstered by an old beekeeper!

Brencis.speaker: Marat
Brencis.statement: Yes, I'm keeping things from you. But they have nothing to do with Brencis or the rebellion.

Brencis.speaker: Coen
Brencis.statement: [sighs] Guess you're right... Even if Catalin isn't my dream sovereign, I sure prefer him to Brencis.

Brencis.speaker: Vicho
Brencis.statement: Alas, I can't join your cause. Don't get me wrong, I have no love for Brencis's regime. He is a vile monster. We all are.

Brencis.speaker: Coen
Brencis.statement: Brencis. During his coronation he... he executed my family.

Brencis.speaker: Coen
Brencis.statement: I thought all vrakhiri believe in the God Brencis told us to worship...

Brencis.speaker: Coen
Brencis.statement: I'm just trying to save my family. They were taken by Brencis, and if I don't do anything soon, he'll execute them.

Brencis.speaker: Vicho
Brencis.statement: It might be Brencis or someone from his clique – they're not very fond of me.

Brencis.speaker: Vicho
Brencis.statement: The truth is, I'm still technically a member of Brencis's clique.

Brencis.speaker: Vicho
Brencis.statement: Brencis's law punishes looters. It says nothing about destroying Jewish property.

Brencis.speaker: Vicho
Brencis.statement: A vrakhiri named Lacra. Don't really know her that well, but she's no ally to Brencis, that's for certain.

Brencis.speaker: 715_messenger
Brencis.statement: In his great wisdom, Knyaz Brencis wants to put a stop to those atrocities and reach a peaceful resolution.

Brencis.speaker: Coen
Brencis.statement: Brencis wants to meet... Might be a trap. Or maybe he's finally scared of me...

Brencis.speaker: Coen
Brencis.statement: Quite a lot. Before Brencis, I wouldn't have guessed that there were so many of you hiding in the mountains.

Brencis.speaker: Lacra
Brencis.statement: Here we go. A shrine to Mihai... Or what's left of it. Now Brencis is the one watching over us here.

Brencis.speaker: Lacra
Brencis.statement: After Brencis turned me, he insisted we left right away, he said there was nothing else to do there.

Brencis.speaker: Coen
Brencis.statement: No, Brencis was right to stop you.

Brencis.speaker: Lacra
Brencis.statement: No, I didn't make him suffer nearly enough. Brencis interrupted us.

Brencis.speaker: Lacra
Brencis.statement: Then Brencis arrived and killed him.

Brencis.speaker: Lacra
Brencis.statement: And Brencis... well, he figured it out instantly, right when we met. And he used it to get exactly what he wanted.

Brencis.speaker: Coen
Brencis.statement: That would've done more good than becoming a tool for Brencis to punish my father. I couldn't fight the vrakhiri! I could barely breathe!

Brencis.speaker: Coen
Brencis.statement: [snort] I don’t recommend it. Last time Brencis did that he nearly burned his face off.

Brencis.speaker: Coen

Brencis.speaker: Coen
Brencis.statement: I... I could feed on animals. Or... or Brencis's men, they deserve it.

Brencis.statement: Knyaz Brencis this, knyaz Brencis that! Ah...

Brencis.speaker: 266FD5C54B92227C3AF946B7D0B59628

Brencis.speaker: Coen
Brencis.statement: Because I need your help. Stopping Brencis, that's what matters.

Brencis.speaker: Vicho
Brencis.statement: But it would be unfair to leave it at that. Brencis is also a man of his word. He does as he promises.

Brencis.speaker: Coen
Brencis.statement: Isbrand tried to stop Brencis but failed. As punishment, he was imprisoned in kobold caves. They... they fed on him.

Brencis.speaker: Coen

Brencis.speaker: Coen
Brencis.statement: You could feed on Brencis's soldiers. They're far from innocent.

Brencis.speaker: Vladimir
Brencis.statement: That way, even if Brencis captures one cell, there's nothing to point him to the next one.

Brencis.statement: How old do you think Brencis is, hm?

Brencis.speaker: C57D489A4727CD62C4AF9294E795B67F
Brencis.statement: Knyaz Brencis is about to build ten new watchtowers on the valley's border.

Brencis.speaker: D2BB60ED4127C19018282C822866DC7F

Brencis.speaker: 57C31F0D49A4D5B588369997AA09B5A8
Brencis.statement: I serve Brencis!

Brencis.speaker: Xanthe
Brencis.statement: Ah. Seems Brencis prepared for the return of his prodigal son.

Brencis.speaker: Xanthe
Brencis.statement: Brencis made life convenient. Then, it cost me everything...

Brencis.speaker: Xanthe
Brencis.statement: Brencis's thirst for power is impossible to quench. He drinks and he drinks... He'll drink until he's burst apart.

Ambrus.speaker: merchant.female01
Ambrus.statement: Last time I checked, boyar Ambrus was handling that.

Ambrus.speaker: Post_Guard
Ambrus.statement: It’ll be a fine day when we drag him in. Boyar Ambrus pays handsomely for traitors.

Ambrus.speaker: peasant.female07
Ambrus.statement: Boyar Ambrus was good...

Ambrus.speaker: peasant.male10
Ambrus.statement: You got lucky Boyar Ambrus came here and changed things, that's for sure.

Ambrus.speaker: peasant.child02

Ambrus.speaker: townsfolk_old.female01
Ambrus.statement: He's dead... Oh, God. Ambrus is finally dead... My husband might rest easier.

Ambrus.speaker: OA101.Collector02
Ambrus.statement: Ah! That's a big one. Boyar Ambrus will be pleased.

Ambrus.speaker: Coen
Ambrus.statement: Oh, I don't think you'll be getting the chance to lick Ambrus's boots ever again.

Ambrus.speaker: OA101.Armed.Collector02

Ambrus.speaker: OA101.Armed.Collector01

Ambrus.speaker: Coen

Ambrus.speaker: OA102.Collector01
Ambrus.statement: You must have a death wish! Boyar Ambrus won't let this slide!

Ambrus.speaker: OA102.Collector04
Ambrus.statement: Boyar Ambrus must be desperate to get these leeches, paying as much as he does for 'em...

Ambrus.speaker: OA102.Armed.Collector03

Ambrus.speaker: Coen
Ambrus.statement: What is Ambrus up to...

Ambrus.speaker: Coen
Ambrus.statement: Good thing they left before Ambrus's men showed up.

Ambrus.speaker: Coen
Ambrus.statement: Shit. Ambrus's men killed them all...

Ambrus.speaker: Coen
Ambrus.statement: Almost half of the collected blood didn't even make it to Ambrus...

Ambrus.speaker: OA108.Prisoner02
Ambrus.statement: One last thing... Be careful. Ambrus – he hates you with all his soul, or what's left of it.

Ambrus.speaker: OA109.Prisoner01
Ambrus.statement: Boyar Ambrus... He's obsessed with you, wants to challenge you to some sort of a - a sick duel.

Ambrus.speaker: Coen
Ambrus.statement: Ambrus isn't the only one to resent the old order.

Ambrus.speaker: OA109.Swordmaster
Ambrus.statement: Ambrus... He hated all nobility, chased after us like a hungry pointer.

Ambrus.speaker: OA109.Swordmaster
Ambrus.statement: Ambrus... He hates all nobility, chases after us like a hungry pointer.

Ambrus.speaker: OA110.SmithApprentice
Ambrus.statement: You'll need all the help you can get... Boyar Ambrus, he swore to cut you down himself.

Ambrus.speaker: OA113.Alchemist
Ambrus.statement: Especially not after what Ambrus has done in Maragir!

Ambrus.speaker: OA113.Alchemist
Ambrus.statement: Of course! I studied under Arnold de Villeneuve! Nature has no secrets from me! But... I kept the truth from Ambrus!

Ambrus.speaker: Coen
Ambrus.statement: Ambrus, Brencis, Xanthe... They want us to believe they're saints.

Ambrus.speaker: Coen
Ambrus.statement: Killed one of his boyars. Ambrus.

Ambrus.speaker: Coen

Ambrus.speaker: Coen

Ambrus.statement: Boyar Ambrus was honourable, fought you in a duel.

Ambrus.speaker: 0E578BF44BD325059F11779C357BEAFA

Ambrus.speaker: 34DF8F8F4E67561A6265E5A60CCDCBF0

Ambrus.speaker: A3010D3B4062ECD8FBE2D3A46BF639E4
Ambrus.statement: Well, at least Ambrus won’t be a problem anymore.

Ambrus.speaker: 4780D92946252298213DA7811F4F8BF8

Ambrus.speaker: Iulian
Ambrus.statement: I have access to Ambrus's cellars.

Ambrus.speaker: Iulian
Ambrus.statement: See, Ambrus doesn't drink from Brencis's communal blood barrels.

Ambrus.speaker: Iulian
Ambrus.statement: Because all I see there is a fucking blood cow crawling at Ambrus's feet, begging to be used.

Ambrus.statement: I can't be a part of this, I'm sorry. I'll kill Ambrus on my own.

Ambrus.speaker: Iulian

Ambrus.speaker: Coen
Ambrus.statement: You're a pawn in Brencis's hands, Ambrus, nothing more. You don't really rule anyone.

Ambrus.statement: [db] shot at Ambrus soldiers, who gasp and run away in terror

Xanthe.speaker: Coen
Xanthe.statement: Well, looks like Xanthe will never learn what happened here.

Xanthe.speaker: Coen
Xanthe.statement: So the caretaker worked for Xanthe... And this was his reward.

Xanthe.speaker: Coen

Xanthe.speaker: q102.Guard11
Xanthe.statement: Who gives a shit? Boyaress Xanthe was clear – kill him!

Xanthe.statement: Still can't believe someone killed boyaress Xanthe...

Xanthe.speaker: q102.guard_without_xanthe1
Xanthe.statement: We're lucky. Boyaress Xanthe is not here tonight.

Xanthe.statement: Looks like Xanthe left us one last surprise…

Xanthe.statement: Xanthe kept thinking of Chariklea as her child, to be protected, entertained, coddled.

Xanthe.statement: I sincerely hoped you'd succeed against Boyaress Xanthe... But I have to admit, I doubted you would.

Xanthe.speaker: Coen
Xanthe.statement: I will not take you with me, Xanthe. I won't let your vile presence sully my soul.

Xanthe.speaker: Lacra
Xanthe.statement: No, and thank God for that, or I'd have ended up like Xanthe – trying to protect them, losing my fucking mind in the process.

Xanthe.speaker: Coen
Xanthe.statement: The way these bodies are preserved... I've seen this before. In Xanthe's keep.

Bakir.speaker: Ambrus
Bakir.statement: Ah, Bakir made an awful mess here.

Bakir.speaker: cc.SideGate.Soldier.4
Bakir.statement: Not if it means I might end up in boyar Bakir's dungeon.

Bakir.speaker: Lacra
Bakir.statement: I don't pity any fool who gets fucked over by Bakir after drinking this. Idiots.

Bakir.speaker: Lacra
Bakir.statement: I see Bakir had his fun here.

Bakir.statement: I know all about your betrayal. Your little deal with Bakir. So you were fine with ignoring orders, as long as it suited you.

Bakir.speaker: Coen
Bakir.statement: And all that at Bakir's behest, it seems.

Bakir.speaker: Coen
Bakir.statement: Bakir's seal... So the boyars don't get along...

Bakir.statement: Judging by their uniforms, they are Bakir's men...

Bakir.speaker: Coen
Bakir.statement: That is where Bakir's men make alcohol...

Bakir.statement: Now Boyar Bakir rules here... he works us to the bone.

Bakir.speaker: OB106.Soldier01
Bakir.statement: Bakir doesn't even know about this place.

Bakir.speaker: OB106.Soldier01
Bakir.statement: With Bakir gone, there's little competition. And we make sure it stays that way, heh.

Bakir.speaker: Vasil
Bakir.statement: Bakir – he's supposed to keep people entertained.

Bakir.statement: Bakir might know. He deals with the goats. Snoop around and maybe you'll get lucky.

Bakir.statement: It was Bakir's playground. We're lucky we didn't run into him here.

Bakir.statement: Not as much as it used to be, since you killed Bakir. That should make things a bit easier.
